excerpt: Describe the flow you want in natural language - the policies, knowledge, and tool connections it combines - and the Internal Agent configures it.
Simulations replay your historical tickets - or mock scenarios - against the configurations in the task, and production tests verify your tool connections.
By default, every action requires manual approval. You can set specific tools to auto-approve per task or automation
Configuration actions publish as a release on the Releases page, where you can track the impact and revert with one click.
An automation is an Internal Agent task that runs on a schedule, like every weekday at 9am, or a trigger, like a GitHub PR merging
Require Slack approval before the refund tool runs on amounts above $100.
